title: Nuclei extraction for 10x Genomics Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression
author: Ignas Masilionis
materials: Nuclei should be stained with 7-AAD (7-Aminoactinomycin D) Thermo Fisher Catalog #A1310 , for sorting. Positive nuclei population can be FACS into 500uL of Nuclei wash buffer using 1.5mL Lobind Eppendorf as collection tube (see attached PDF for gating setup example). Suggested nozzle size: 100um. Ideally, aim to collect >200 000 nuclei. Sort_Report_DAPI_pos_Nuclei.pdf

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Cartridges
steps.instruction: Prepare the Singulator and necessary cartridges for nuclei isolation.

substeps.instruction: Turn on and pre-cool Singulator for 10 minutes.
Ensure sufficient Nuclei cartridges (or NIC+ cartridges for samples <20mg) are stored and pre-cooled at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sample
steps.instruction: Isolate the tissue while maintaining cryogenic temperatures to prevent thawing.

substeps.instruction: Remove tissue from LN2 or -80°C freezer and place on dry ice.
Cut the tissue (ideally 10mg) using a razor blade within a petri dish on dry ice.
Use cooled, RNAse-free tweezers to handle tissue.
Immediately place the cut tissue back into a tube on dry ice.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Wash Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 2mL of Nuclei Wash Buffer per sample with the following final concentrations:

substeps.instruction: Tris-HCl (pH 7.4): 10 mM
NaCl: 10 mM
MgCl2: 3 mM
Purified BSA: 1%
DTT: 1 mM
RNAse inhibitor (Protector RNase Inhibitor Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #3335402001): 0.2 - 1.0 U/uL depending on tissue type
Top-off to 2mL with Ambion Nuclease-free water.

steps.title: Isolate Nuclei using Singulator
steps.instruction: Perform nuclei isolation using the Singulator system.

substeps.instruction: Add RNAse inhibitor (0.2-1.0 U/uL final) and DTT (3.5uL of 1 M DTT for a final concentration of 1mM) directly into the Nuclei Isolation Cartridge before adding tissue (Final volume ~3.5 mL for standard protocol).
Transfer tissue into the cooled Nuclei Isolation Cartridge and start the standard nuclei isolation protocol.

steps.title: Collect Nuclei Suspension
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting nuclei suspension into appropriate tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer ~3.5mL of nuclei suspension into 5mL Protein LoBind eppendorf tubes (or split evenly into four 1.5mL Protein LoBind eppendorf tubes with conical bottoms).

steps.title: Perform Sucrose Cushion Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Concentrate nuclei and remove debris using a sucrose cushion.

substeps.instruction: Add 500uL 2 M Sucrose solution to the tube (to achieve 250 mM final concentration); adjust volume if using 1.5mL tubes.
Invert the tube slowly at least 10 times to mix (do not vortex).
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C using a swinging bucket centrifuge.
Aspirate the supernatant and debris layer using a P1000 pipette, leaving ~50uL to avoid disrupting the nuclei pellet.

steps.title: Resuspend and Count Nuclei
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and verify nuclei concentration.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the nuclei pellet in ~400uL Nuclei Wash Buffer (adjust based on tissue input and pellet size).
Count nuclei using DAPI on an automated cell counter (e.g., Countess II) or Trypan in bright field.

steps.title: Filter Nuclei Suspension
steps.instruction: Remove aggregates by filtering the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Filter the suspension through a 35 μm FACS tube cap filter (blue) or 30 μm Pre-separation filters (Miltenyi).
Perform a second wash with Nuclei Wash buffer to remove sucrose traces (important for FACS sorting).
Perform a second wash with 250mM sucrose if high amounts of debris or fat remain.

steps.title: Concentrate and Resuspend Sorted Nuclei
steps.instruction: Concentrate the nuclei post-sorting to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C using a swinging bucket centrifuge.
Resuspend sorted nuclei with Nuclei Wash buffer to achieve >=1000 nuclei/uL based on FACS numbers.
Verify count using DAPI on Countess II cell counter.

steps.title: Final Aliquoting and Lysis Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the final nuclei aliquot for the 10X Genomics protocol.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 200k nuclei into a 0.2mL PCR tube.
Centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C using a swinging bucket centrifuge.
Precisely remove the supernatant, leaving exactly 5uL (calculate: Aliquot volume minus 5uL).

Proceed to 10X Genomics Nuclei Isolation for Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression Sequencing protocol CG000365, following 'Low Cell Input Nuclei Isolation' in Appendix starting at step e, omitting NP40 from lysis buffer and performing lysis for 30s.
